review_note: Read the test and helpers. Independent base-R dense Laplace oracle with ape::vcv through cov2cor for the tree (package helper compared with it at 1e-8 on all three phylo fixtures), Henderson tabular A from an inbred pedigree, a hand relmat kernel (Ainv and Q by solve) and a hand spatial kernel. logLik agrees within 1e-4 for each fit, and provider oracle values agree within 1e-6 (A, Ainv and pedigree; K and Q). Each emulated bug (swap, reversed SD, raw vcv for phylo, cov2cor(K) and K x 2 for animal or relmat, kernel read by position) is asserted to move the oracle by more than 0.1. All 12 row_keys are fitted: logit phylo+animal for A, Ainv and pedigree; phylo+relmat K and Q for the three links; phylo+spatial for the three links. Each field is an intercept with sd ~ covariate on its own factor, so there is no slope-member issue. Hashes match, and the console shows 220 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, exit 0, with no Julia. Does NOT establish: probit or cloglog phylo+animal (not fitted here); slope, labelled or correlated blocks; calibration, coverage, SE or recovery; Julia parity; any seed beyond the fixed ones (one per block or link); kernel-scale sensitivity for the phylo and spatial fields beyond raw vcv and position reading; behaviour away from the fitted optimum.
